items.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: single adult full-body Chinese historical summer character cutout for game random portrait library. Photos are identity and visible build references ONLY; new costume, pose and composition. Realistic graceful costume photography, natural skin texture, accurate individual face over generic doll beauty. Healthy slender adult proportions about 7.5 heads tall, proportionate small head, natural neck, slim shoulders/arms/waist and long natural legs. Light silk/gauze Chinese historical summer clothing, opaque lining, tasteful elegance. All figures BAREFOOT: exactly two coherent arms, two hands each with five fingers, two legs, two correctly oriented bare feet with five toes each, natural joints and gravity. Entire hair, ornaments, hands, hems, toes and props within portrait 2:3 canvas with clear margins, no clipping. GENUINE transparent alpha, no scene/floor/shadow/halo/text/watermark or modern items. Soft neutral natural light, normal 70mm perspective. Subject: Zhang Zifeng 张子枫 adult age 21 as in 2023 forest photos. Image 1 PRIMARY face/soft beauty reference (clear eyes, brows, delicate nose, natural lips); image 2 supports facial contour and adult body build. Preserve recognizable Zhang Zifeng identity, make expression naturally tender and composed with a subtle CLOSED-LIP smile, clean natural makeup, eyes toward camera. Do not reuse old punk short-haired portrait or its stern side profile. Newly generated whole character, head upright and face near-front with very slight three-quarter turn, no dramatically tilted chin. Graceful relaxed standing contrapposto with both bare feet visible and naturally grounded slightly apart. Bamboo-green short-sleeved thin silk wrap blouse over ivory lined bodice, flowing pale ivory long skirt ending above toes with fine bamboo and jasmine embroidery, light mint gauze ribbons behind arms. Both hands gently support a bamboo flute horizontally low at waist with relaxed natural fingers. Soft black hair in loose half-updo with silver jasmine comb and pearl pins, small jade drop earrings, delicate necklace, jade bangle, embroidered waist sachet and tassels. Keep torso full adult size and slender harmonious limbs. Do not copy forest, modern knitwear, trousers or leaf covering eye.
